mainEntity.name: What factors influence the cost of a textured-to-smooth ceiling conversion?

acceptedAnswer.text: The total cost depends on ceiling height, total square footage, the type of texture, and whether paint covers the texture. Standard unpainted popcorn that scrapes off cleanly requires less labor than heavy knockdown or painted swirl textures that demand multiple skim coats or drywall overlays. Vaulted or high ceilings require specialized staging and ladders, which increases setup time. Repairing hidden drywall flaws, fixing loose tape seams beneath old texture, and applying a quality primer and two finish paint coats also factor into total project estimates.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs depend on ceiling height, room size, texture type, previous paint layers, the labor needed for skim coating or drywall repairs, and final painting requirements.
